# Imprints and Endgame Crafting

by BinaQcLast Updated: April 1, 2026

### Advertisement

This website is supported by ads.

Imprints are one of the most powerful crafting mechanics in Last Epoch. They let you duplicate, manipulate, and upgrade Items, making them the cornerstone of creating Multi Exalted Items, including Double Tier 7. This article teaches you everything you need to know about Imprints, and how to craft items with desired Multi Exalted Affixes.

## The Imprint System

Imprints and Endgame Crafting
Equipment Imprint nodes location
Imprints are tied to the Weaver’s Tree and come in two forms: Equipment Imprints, where you place your own gear (such as a Ring or Helmet), and Woven Echo Imprints, where you place a Woven Echo. Corrupted items can't be Imprinted.

Similar item drops from Imprints are determined by many different factors:

#### Base Type

The base type is the foundation for what counts as similar. For example, Imprinting a Ring means you’ll see more Rings. There is also a chance an item can shift to a different class. For example, a Mage item Imprint may drop as a Rogue item of the same base type.

#### Affixes

The specific Affixes and their Tiers influence Imprint drops. This also includes Open Affixes. Sealed Affixes are removed.

#### Forging Potential

Forging Potential also influences Imprint drops. FP higher than 40-50 is recommended. Items dropped from a Nemesis often have upwards of 60 FP.

#### Unique Items

Uniques have an increased chance to drop as the same Unique you imprinted. When this happens, Legendary Potential is also taken into account. In addition, Legendary Affixes are treated the same as Legendary Potential. For example, an item with one Legendary Affix is considered equivalent to having 1 LP.

#### Corruption

Corruption influences this system and makes higher Corruption more rewarding as long as you can maintain efficient farming.

## Imprint Nodes

Imprints and Endgame Crafting

### Echoing Riches

This Imprint activates when you receive Echo rewards. This refers to the Echo reward rock in the center of the Echo of a World, not the chest to the right. A good way to farm this one is by running Sepulchre of the Lost, since all the chests at the end can trigger this Imprint.

### Sealed Riches

This Imprint activates when you open Lost Caches. A reliable way to trigger it is by running the Unclaimed Trove or Vault of the Barnacle King.

### Commoner's Riches

This Imprint triggers when you kill enemies in regular echoes, which means any echo that is not a Woven Echo or a Quest Echo.

### Warlord's Riches

This Imprint activates when you kill Champions. It’s especially useful for obtaining sealed Tier 7 Affixes and can produce some powerful Exalted items. However, it’s harder to get a truly good result compared to the other Imprints, since it doesn’t drop a similar item like the other Imprints do. The number of items it generates is based on the number of Affixes on the Imprinted item, including any sealed Affixes. Aim to Imprint an item with all Affixes filled.

### Woven Riches & Loomed Riches

These Imprints have a chance to generate the specific Woven Echo you’ve imprinted whenever a new Echo spawns on your Echo Web. This allows you to target farm the Imprinted Woven Echo without consuming it.

## Obtaining Imprint Item Bases

Imprints and Endgame Crafting

Double Tier 7 items are considered the Endgame standard when min-maxing a character. The ideal Imprint consists of a base item with two Tier 7 affixes. There are several ways to acquire them:

#### Natural Drops

Double T7s can drop naturally. Guides on Maxroll already include Loot Filter rules for them.

#### Nemesis

Nemesis upgrades affixes into exalted tiers, with higher chances if you’re in Circle of Fortune (CoF) because of the Rank Rewards. Conquered Tower is one of the most reliable way to farm Double Tier 7 items.

#### Prophecies

A last resort, since Prophecies are often better spent on Idols, Uniques, or other upgrades. Still, if you’re missing a Double Tier 7 for a slot, it’s an option.

#### Merchant's Guild

Buying an item from the Bazaar is also an option. Keep in mind that any Imprints triggered from an item bought from the Bazaar are untradable since they keep their tags.

## Endgame Imprint Crafting

Imprints and Endgame Crafting
In order to obtain your desired item reliably, first you need to setup a good Imprint, trigger it one or more times, and then craft the final item. Remember to keep re-imprinting between each successful steps, if the item improved, especially if it retains high Forging Potential.

- Your first double Tier 7 item drop most likely won't match your ideal Imprint.
- Start by Imprinting it, and then craft your way towards your ideal Imprint with the new items it generates.
- Always keep your best Imprint Base safely stored, so that you can re-imprint it whenever you need another of that item base.

The crafting process is shown assuming a starting item with Four Affixes and two randomly placed Tier 7 Affixes. While there is more than one way to setup a good item to Imprint, here are three proven methods to consider, depending on where you want the Tier 7 affixes to end up on the final item.

### Two Wanted Prefixes

It might seem counter intuitive, but you want to craft the Imprint base with two Tier 7 Suffixes, one Prefix, and one Open Prefix. This way, you can almost guarantee obtaining your 2 wanted Tier 7 Prefixes by using the following steps:

Final Item With Two Wanted Prefixes

#### Crafting the Imprint Base

- Use Rune of Havoc until both Suffixes are Tier 7.
- Create an Open Prefix:
- Seal (Glyph of Despair) an unwanted Prefix if Tier 1 (100%) or Tier 2 (69%)
- If Tier 3 or higher, use Rune of Removal instead.

- You now have your Imprint Base.
- Imprint it on the Weaver Tree.

#### Crafting the Final Item

Once you get more Imprint drops, craft your Final Item with these steps:

- Craft one wanted Prefix in the Open Prefix slot
- Seal (Glyph of Despair) the Tier 1 unwanted Prefix.
- Craft the second wanted Prefix.
- Use Rune of Havoc until both Tier 7 land on Prefixes.
- For Legendary/Unique crafts, use a Rune of Refinement if necessary, and reserve some FP to finish with a Rune of Creation to duplicate the craft.
- For an Exalted you plan to equip, use the standard crafting tools to upgrade the item into your desired sub-type (Glyph of Envy), well rolled Implicit (Rune of Shaping), and Explicit Affixes (Rune of Refinement).

### Two Wanted Suffixes

Imprint an item with two Tier 7 Prefixes, one Suffix, and one Open Suffix.

Final Item With Two Wanted Suffixes

#### Crafting the Imprint Base

- Use Rune of Havoc until both Prefixes are Tier 7.
- Create an Open Suffix:
- Seal (Glyph of Despair) an unwanted Suffix if Tier 1 (100%) or Tier 2 (69%)
- If Tier 3 or higher, use Rune of Removal instead.

- You now have your Imprint Base.
- Imprint it on the Weaver Tree.

#### Crafting the Final Item

Once you get more Imprint drops, craft your Final Item with these steps:

- Craft one wanted Suffix in the Open Suffix slot
- Seal (Glyph of Despair) the Tier 1 unwanted Suffix.
- Craft the second wanted Suffix.
- Use Rune of Havoc until both Tier 7 land on Suffixes.
- For Legendary/Unique crafts, use a Rune of Refinement if necessary, and reserve some FP to finish with a Rune of Creation to duplicate the craft.
- For an Exalted you plan to equip, use the standard crafting tools to upgrade the item into your desired sub-type (Glyph of Envy), well rolled Implicit (Rune of Shaping), and Explicit Affixes (Rune of Refinement).

### One Wanted Prefix & Suffix

Imprint an item with one Tier 7 Prefix and one Tier 7 Suffix, one Affix, and one Open Affix.

Final Item With One Wanted Prefix and Suffix

#### Crafting the Imprint Base

- Use Rune of Havoc until one Prefix and one Suffix are Tier 7.
- Create an Open Affix:
- Seal (Glyph of Despair) an unwanted Affix if Tier 1 (100%) or Tier 2 (69%)
- If Tier 3 or higher, use Rune of Removal instead.

- You now have your Imprint Base.
- Imprint it on the Weaver Tree.

#### Crafting the Final Item

Once you get more Imprint drops, craft your Final Item with these steps:

- Craft one wanted Affix in the Open Affix slot.
- Seal (Glyph of Despair) the Tier 1 unwanted Affix.
- Craft the second wanted Affix.
- Use Rune of Havoc until both Tier 7 land on wanted Affixes.
- For Legendary/Unique crafts, use a Rune of Refinement if necessary, and reserve some FP to finish with a Rune of Creation to duplicate the craft.
- For an Exalted you plan to equip, use the standard crafting tools to upgrade the item into your desired sub-type (Glyph of Envy), well rolled Implicit (Rune of Shaping), and Explicit Affixes (Rune of Refinement).

## Summary

Imprints and Endgame Crafting
- Imprint gear and Woven Echoes into the Weaver Tree.
- Corrupted items can't be Imprinted.
- Run content that matches the Imprint you want to trigger.
- Replace Imprints with better ones as you find or craft them.
- Use the crafting process to achieve your desired Double Tier 7s.
